title: Luxurious Laminated Norwegian Mussels Paella
description: A rich and snappy Norwegian dish featuring mussels and lamination-puff, perfect for a midnight craving, this flexitarian-friendly paella is a must try.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the laminated puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mussels to the skillet, cover, and cook until they open.
Stir in the smoked paprika, saffron threads with their soaking liquid, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange the mussels in a single layer on one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water, then fold the other half of the pastry over the mussels to form a triangle or rectangle.
Press the edges of the pastry to seal and use a knife to cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the paella on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the paella from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
